WITH documents AS MATERIALIZED (
            SELECT project_id,id,version,version_id,recorded_at,superseded_at,payload::jsonb AS body
            FROM record_versions WHERE project_id=? AND superseded_at IS NULL
              AND read_kind='document' AND read_visible
        ) SELECT project_id,id,version,version_id,
            recorded_at,superseded_at,
            jsonb_build_object('id',id,'kind','document',
                'valid_from',body->'valid_from',
                'valid_until',body->'valid_until',
                'metadata',jsonb_build_object('title',COALESCE(body#>>'{metadata,title}',id),
                    'discovery_candidates',body#>'{metadata,discovery_candidates}'))::text AS payload
            FROM documents WHERE jsonb_typeof(body#>'{metadata,discovery_candidates}')='array'
            ORDER BY id

SELECT read_kind AS kind,
                jsonb_build_object('discovery_candidate_id',payload::jsonb#>'{metadata,discovery_candidate_id}',
                    'discovery_candidate_ids',payload::jsonb#>'{metadata,discovery_candidate_ids}')::text AS metadata
            FROM record_versions WHERE project_id=? AND superseded_at IS NULL
              AND read_visible AND read_kind IN ('entity','relation','attribute')
              AND (payload::jsonb#>>'{metadata,discovery_candidate_id}'=ANY(?::text[])
                OR (payload::jsonb#>'{metadata,discovery_candidate_ids}' IS NOT NULL
                    AND (payload::jsonb#>'{metadata,discovery_candidate_ids}') @> ANY(?::jsonb[])))

WITH qualified AS (
            SELECT r.id,r.version,r.version_id,r.read_kind AS kind,
                    r.read_type AS type,NULLIF(r.read_type,'') AS group_type,
                    NULLIF(r.payload::jsonb->>'ontology_id','') AS ontology_id
                FROM record_versions r WHERE r.project_id=? AND r.superseded_at IS NULL AND r.read_visible AND TRUE AND r.read_kind = ? UNION ALL SELECT r.id,r.version,r.version_id,r.read_kind AS kind,
                    r.read_type AS type,NULLIF(r.read_type,'') AS group_type,
                    NULLIF(r.payload::jsonb->>'ontology_id','') AS ontology_id
                FROM record_versions r WHERE r.project_id=? AND r.superseded_at IS NULL AND r.read_visible AND TRUE AND r.read_kind = ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_versions s WHERE s.id=r.read_subject_id AND s.read_kind='entity' AND s.project_id=? AND s.superseded_at IS NULL AND s.read_visible AND TRUE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_versions t WHERE t.id=r.read_object_id AND t.read_kind='entity' AND t.project_id=? AND t.superseded_at IS NULL AND t.read_visible AND TRUE) UNION ALL SELECT r.id,r.version,r.version_id,r.read_kind AS kind,
                    r.read_type AS type,NULLIF(r.read_type,'') AS group_type,
                    NULLIF(r.payload::jsonb->>'ontology_id','') AS ontology_id
                FROM record_versions r WHERE r.project_id=? AND r.superseded_at IS NULL AND r.read_visible AND TRUE AND r.read_kind = ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_versions s WHERE s.id=r.read_subject_id AND s.read_kind='entity' AND s.project_id=? AND s.superseded_at IS NULL AND s.read_visible AND TRUE)
        ), ranked AS (
            SELECT q.*,row_number() OVER (
                PARTITION BY ontology_id,kind,group_type ORDER BY id,version) AS position
            FROM qualified q
        ) SELECT ontology_id,kind,
            max(type) FILTER (WHERE position=1) AS type,count(*) AS record_count,
            array_agg(version_id ORDER BY id,version) FILTER (
                WHERE ontology_id IS DISTINCT FROM ? AND position<=?) AS sample_version_ids
          FROM ranked GROUP BY ontology_id,kind,group_type
          ORDER BY ontology_id NULLS FIRST,kind,group_type NULLS FIRST

WITH documents AS MATERIALIZED (
            SELECT project_id,id,version,version_id,recorded_at,superseded_at,payload::jsonb AS body
            FROM record_versions WHERE project_id=? AND version_id=ANY(?::text[])
        ) SELECT r.project_id,r.id,r.version,r.version_id,
            r.recorded_at,r.superseded_at,jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'kind','document',
                'valid_from',r.body->'valid_from','valid_until',r.body->'valid_until',
                'metadata',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('title',r.body#>'{metadata,title}','source_file',r.body#>'{metadata,source_file}','source_format',r.body#>'{metadata,source_format}','source_size_bytes',r.body#>'{metadata,source_size_bytes}','document_parser',r.body#>'{metadata,document_parser}','page_count',r.body#>'{metadata,page_count}','source_document_version_id',r.body#>'{metadata,source_document_version_id}','status',r.body#>'{metadata,status}')))::text AS payload
            FROM documents r

WITH associations AS (SELECT a.document_id,a.canonical_record_id FROM assertions a
                WHERE a.project_id=? AND a.document_id=ANY(?::text[])
                  AND a.status='accepted' AND a.canonical_record_id IS NOT NULL), linked AS MATERIALIZED (
            SELECT a.document_id,r.id,r.version FROM associations a
              JOIN record_versions r ON r.project_id=? AND r.id=a.canonical_record_id
            UNION
            SELECT payload::jsonb->>'source_id',id,version FROM record_versions
            WHERE project_id=? AND payload::jsonb->>'source_id'=ANY(?::text[])
        ), matches AS (
            SELECT l.document_id,r.read_kind AS kind,r.id,r.read_type AS type,r.read_text AS text,
                count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.document_id,r.read_kind) AS total,
                row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.document_id,r.read_kind ORDER BY r.id,r.version) AS position
            FROM linked l JOIN record_versions r ON r.id=l.id AND r.version=l.version
            WHERE r.project_id=? AND r.superseded_at IS NULL AND r.read_visible AND TRUE AND r.read_kind = ANY(?::text[]) AND (r.read_kind NOT IN ('relation','attribute') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_versions s WHERE s.id=r.read_subject_id AND s.read_kind='entity' AND s.project_id=? AND s.superseded_at IS NULL AND s.read_visible AND TRUE OFFSET 0) AND (r.read_kind='attribute' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_versions t WHERE t.id=r.read_object_id AND t.read_kind='entity' AND t.project_id=? AND t.superseded_at IS NULL AND t.read_visible AND TRUE OFFSET 0))))
        ) SELECT document_id,kind,id,type,text,total FROM matches
          WHERE position<=CASE kind WHEN 'chunk' THEN 10 WHEN 'attribute' THEN 1 ELSE 20 END
          ORDER BY document_id,kind,position
